description:
Check the running instance (systemd + HTTP). Read-only.

    Pass domain + origin_ip for a box behind Cloudflare and it ALSO measures whether the
    origin still answers people who skip Cloudflare (curl --resolve, from this machine).
    A box that is "healthy" while answering direct requests is not finished: Access, the
    WAF and the rate limits are all bypassable there.
name: health_check
